question: Under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana, the maximum premium payable by the farmers will be _________ for horticulture crops.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5%**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** maximum premium that farmers pay for horticulture crops under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is 5% of the sum insure**d. 
 
• The PMFBY is a** crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers** who lose their crops due to natural disasters. 
 
• The premium for **horticulture crops is 5% of the sum insured, or the actuarial rate, whichever is lower. **
 
• The** premium for Kharif crops is 2% of the sum insured, or the actuarial rate, whichever is lower. **
 
• The premium for Rabi crops is 1.5% of the sum insured, or the actuarial rate, whichever is lower. 
 
• The Central and State Governments share the premium that is above these limits in a 50:50 ratio. 
 
• In the North Eastern Region, the Central and State Governments share the premium in a 90:10 ratio. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Horticultural crops are plants that are grown for food, medicine, and aesthetics. **
 
• **They include fruits, vegetables, flowers, herbs, and ornamental plants. **
 
• **Examples of horticultural crops **
 
 
• Fruits: Apples, bananas, grapes, guava, litchi, and tomatoes
 
• Vegetables: A variety of vegetables
 
• Flowers: A variety of flowers, including those used in landscaping
 
• Ornamental plants: Plants used in landscaping, such as ornamental trees and shrubs
 
• Grapes: Grown for wine production
